nodes.label: OAuth Complete Bypass of Anti-Bot Controls
nodes.rationale: OAuth registration skips all anti-bot controls (Turnstile, honeypots, proof-of-work) making mass bot registration trivial via puppeteer plus rotating free accounts.

nodes.label: Turnstile Fail-Open Design
nodes.rationale: Turnstile middleware returns true when TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY is unset or Cloudflare is unreachable, silently disabling bot protection in production.

nodes.label: No Centralized Auth Middleware
nodes.rationale: No centralized isAuthenticated middleware exists; dozens of state-mutating routes are completely public, allowing arbitrary player manipulation.

nodes.label: Race Condition Double-Spending in Economy
nodes.rationale: All write transactions use READ COMMITTED isolation without row-level locking; concurrent trades, shop purchases, and daily rewards are vulnerable to double-spending and negative balances.

nodes.label: SELECT * Latent Credential Leak Risk
nodes.rationale: 86 SELECT * statements across backend services load password hashes, TOTP secrets, and PII into memory; one missed destructuring by a caller causes credential leakage.

nodes.label: Negative Limit Bypasses Pagination Caps
nodes.rationale: Math.min(Number(req.query.limit) || 100, 100) treats LIMIT -1 as no limit because Math.min(-1, 100) = -1, allowing attackers to dump entire tables.

nodes.label: Blind Ownership Transfer in Trade Execution
nodes.rationale: Trade execution updates stove and lootbox owner unconditionally without verifying the seller still owns the item, enabling item theft when ownership changes after listing.

nodes.label: Missing Unique Constraints on Listing Table
nodes.rationale: No unique constraint prevents multiple active listings for the same item; TOCTOU race condition allows double-listing and selling one item twice.

nodes.label: First Impressions Guiding Principles
nodes.rationale: Optional never blocking; explain in plain English; show don't tell; polish over quantity

nodes.label: Epic 8: First Impressions & Onboarding
nodes.rationale: Onboarding must be optional and dismissible to avoid slowing power users; plain English explanations replace jargon; show-don't-tell approach uses screenshots and animations.

nodes.label: Notification Grouping & Deduplication
nodes.rationale: 5-minute grouping window: if an unread notification with the same (playerId, type, groupKey) exists and updatedAt is within 5 minutes, increment count instead of creating new

nodes.label: Notification Priority System
nodes.rationale: Three-tier priority (low/normal/high) to differentiate notification urgency; low-priority grouped notifications expire after 7 days, normal/high never auto-expire

nodes.label: Notification Auto-expiry
nodes.rationale: Low-priority grouped notifications expire after 7 days; cleanup on read or via periodic job

nodes.label: Tooltip Accessibility Pattern
nodes.rationale: Implements accessible tooltips using aria-describedby, role=tooltip, and keyboard focus/blur handlers for WCAG compliance.

nodes.label: SQLite to PostgreSQL Test Migration
nodes.rationale: All service unit tests were placeholdered after migrating from SQLite to PostgreSQL. The previous mock-based tests used synchronous APIs that no longer match the async Unit/Statement interface.

nodes.label: Async Mock Pattern
nodes.rationale: When rewriting tests: MockUnit.prepare should return MockStatements with async jest.fn().mockResolvedValue(...); all service method calls need await; executeStmt returns Promise<[boolean, number]> not [boolean, number].

nodes.label: Integration Test Strategy
nodes.rationale: Consider using integration tests against a real test DB instead of heavy mocking.
